product_family: AI-powered writing and grammar instruction platform for K-12 education, including tools for sentence combining (Quill Connect), reading comprehension with evidence-based writing (Quill Reading for Evidence), grammar diagnostics, proofreading, and whole-class lessons.

certifications.name: Common Sense Media Privacy Seal
certifications.proof_quote: Quill is proud to receive a 92% privacy rating by Common Sense Education, meaning it meets high standards for data protection and follows best practices for student privacy.

certifications.name: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) Compliant
certifications.proof_quote: Quill operates as a 'School Official' under FERPA, using student information 'only for authorized educational purposes as directed by the School'... Schools manage student data deletion through their partnerships team.

certifications.name: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) Compliant
certifications.proof_quote: For children under 13, Quill relies on schools to provide parental consent for information collection for educational purposes. Schools must 'obtain any consents required from Parents' and provide appropriate disclosures regarding student data use.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliant (EU/UK/EEA Rights)
certifications.proof_quote: Users have rights to: access and data portability, rectification of inaccurate information, erasure under certain conditions, processing restrictions, objection to processing, and consent withdrawal. Users may also lodge complaints with relevant supervisory authorities.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1 or Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification found on vendor domain or dedicated security documentation.

certifications.name: ISO 27001 (Information Security Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found on vendor domain or dedicated security documentation.

certifications.name: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. Quill.org is an educational platform; HIPAA applies to covered healthcare entities and business associates only.

certifications.name: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification. While Quill.org accepts payments via Stripe (PCI-compliant processor), there is no indication of direct PCI DSS certification for Quill itself.

privacy.ai_training_note: Quill de-identifies student data per FERPA before any AI model development. Training datasets are built by educators (40-100 student response examples paired with educator feedback per writing prompt), not from raw student records. The vendor explicitly states: 'Before using education records for AI development, Quill removes identifiers so the remaining information cannot reasonably be used to identify an individual student' per FERPA standards. Uses Google Gemini and OpenAI for AI processing, but only with de-identified data.
privacy.data_region: United States (data stored, processed, and transmitted in US)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Data encrypted during transmission over public Internet using SSL/TLS (secure socket layer or similar technologies)

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Data encrypted when stored at rest

security.name: Access Controls & Authentication
security.value: SSO (single sign-on) and secure rostering to ensure only authorized members can access; secure rostering integrations with Google Classroom and Clever

security.name: Regular Security Audits & Monitoring
security.value: Security infrastructure continuously monitored and regularly audited

security.name: No Data Sales
security.value: Explicitly stated: 'We do not sell your personal information to third parties' and 'We will never sell Student Personal Data.'

security.name: No Targeted Advertising
security.value: Ad-free learning environment; no tracking cookies; no targeted ads based on user activity

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Incident response procedures documented; data processing agreements with vendors required

security.name: Third-Party Processors (Subprocessors)
security.value: Cloud: AWS, Google, Heroku, Azure Cognitive Services. AI: Google Gemini, OpenAI. Analytics: Google Analytics, Ortto. Support: Intercom, Vitally. Other: Stripe (payments), SendGrid (email), Inspectlet (analytics). All contractually obligated to maintain security and confidentiality.

flags: No SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certifications publicly documented (typical for educational nonprofits, but worth noting for enterprise requirements)
Data processing in US only may create GDPR compliance concerns for non-US residents outside US jurisdiction
Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is available but requires manual request to partnerships team (not included in standard Terms of Service)
Uses third-party AI services (Google Gemini, OpenAI) for AI-powered feedback; verify data flow and data processing terms with AI vendors
No public evidence of formal ISO 27701 (Privacy Extension) or ISO 42001 (AI Governance) certifications, despite strong documented ethical AI practices
